title: Texts Sam the request
does: This booking needs Sam's OK, so Rosie texts Sam the request. The clock runs only in Sam's text hours. Nothing is charged for this visit until the OK.
more: The owner names who answers: Sam, the office manager, or an expert. The first answer counts.
No answer in 30 minutes: the customer is told to wait, and Sam gets one reminder.
No answer in 4 of Sam's text hours: not booked.
The plug-in can shorten the time to answer, like when someone is at risk. It always ends before the visit.
Sam can set OK rules by date range, like busy holidays.
An answer after the deadline: check the time is still free, then ask the customer again.
A yes after free cancel ended, on a request made before it, shows today's terms. It needs a fresh yes, where the booking can keep a fee.
Means '2 Another time': Sam offers another time, read back first.
Never: take money or confirm before Sam's yes.
Safe default: not booked; nothing is charged for this visit.
